paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 2.19, with a 12.31 percent increase from the prior close and a 14.12 percent decrease over the last 22 trading sessions. There have been 3 new news articles in the last 24 hours. Recent news headlines include Fermi Inc. Climbs 16% After Customer Funding Arrives, FRMI: Fermi Inc. filed SEC Form 8-K: Other Events, and FRMI stock jumps after Fermi secures $200M prepayment with 'unnamed hyperscaler'.

The recent news appears to be driven by the company's announcement that it has fulfilled the obligations under a customer prepay agreement and received the amounts due, as well as the securing of a $200M prepayment with an unnamed hyperscaler. This agreement supports the development of 600 MW of power capacity at Project Matador in Texas.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a Form 8-K filed on November 23, which announced the fulfillment of the customer prepay agreement, and multiple Form 144 filings on November 20, which were notices of proposed sales by insiders. Additionally, there have been 2 new social posts in the last 24 hours, including discussions of the stock's jump after the prepayment announcement and its appearance on a list of pre-market top gainers.
